summary.text: Your clinic may have stopped operating, changed ownership, or stopped taking part in Healthier SG.

details.heading: Why this happened
details.body: Your clinic may have stopped operating, changed ownership, or stopped taking part in the Healthier SG scheme.

details.heading: What this means
details.body: You can no longer receive Healthier SG benefits at this clinic.

quotes.text: This could be due to various reasons, such as, your clinic has ceased operations, changed ownership, or is no longer participating in the Healthier SG scheme.
This means that you will not be able to enjoy Healthier SG benefits at this clinic anymore.
